items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Varicellum used the rubber, you know. Varicellum. But he's only fast fingering, finger fast.

ctx.x: What about Kid Rene? Did he play much open horn or with mutes too?
Mostly open, mostly wide open all the time. Varicellum used the rubber, you know. Varicellum. But he's only fast fingering, finger fast.
When you played with Chris or heard him play, who else was in the band, can you remember? Ooh. Anybody else at all? I know you had all of them, but some of them maybe.
